messages:
ana (support): Hi — Emily from Acme Supply reported a failed supplier payout. Customer says the corporate AmEx card was declined at payout time with a bank response referencing an MCC block. Ticket #INC-4529 and vendor invoice 8427 attached.

emily (customer): I see the decline on our end — bank message: 'DECLINED - MCC NOT AUTHORIZED'. We need this to go through today, vendor is waiting.

ana (support): typo — Ana here. Can you paste the raw payment provider response? Screenshots help.

emily (customer): screenshot uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/snap/8427.png 

emily (customer): provider webhooks show: status=failed code=pm_3MZkqH reason='card_declined' decline_code='merchant_category_blocked' provider_resp='402: MCC not permitted for this card'

ana (support): thanks. Repro steps I ran: 
1) POST /v1/payouts create with customer_payment_method=pm_3MZkqH 
2) provider returned 402 with decline_code 'merchant_category_blocked'

ana (support): Derek — can you confirm if our reconciliation mapping is sending an MCC? The vendor (Acme Supply) is categorized as 'industrial_tools' MCC 5039 in our vendor DB.

derek (payments): I see the payout request payload contains mcc=5039. Our gateway forwarded mcc=5039 in the /payouts call at 2024-10-11T14:12:09Z. Gateway replied: {"status":"failed","code":402,"decline_code":"merchant_category_blocked","message":"MCC 5039 not permitted for this cardholder"}.

derek (payments): Quick checks: card has corporate spend policy (Amex corp) that forbids 'hardware/tools' merchant categories, and customer-level spend limit is fine. This looks like MCC restriction on the card product, not our routing limits.

ana (support): Can we offer the vendor alternate route (ACH) or ask customer billing admin to whitelist MCC? Emily — do you have the ability to request an MCC allowlist from AmEx?

emily (customer): I can ask but it may take 48+ hours. Vendor prefers immediate payout. Any temporary workaround?

leo (finance): We can attempt manual override by switching payment method to the company bank account (ACH/stripe_bank) for this single invoice. Need customer approval to store ACH as payout method. That avoids MCC entirely.

emily (customer): We can provide ACH today. How do we switch for this payout only?

ana (support): Steps: 1) Customer provide ACH token or bank last4 and routing. 2) We create a one-off payout using funding_source=bank_xxx. I'll coordinate with Derek to send a safe link for bank details.

billing-bot: Payment gateway alert: merchant mcc 5039 flagged by issuer rules for card pm_3MZkqH. Related tickets: INC-4471, INC-4529.

derek (payments): I'll enable a temporary routing rule for test pmt if they provide ACH: use provider 'stripe_bank' and set meta.reference=invoice_8427. I'll wait for green light from customer before initiating.

ryan (eng): FYI — I noticed our vendor classification pipeline recently recategorized 'Acme Supply' from mcc 5045 -> 5039 after vendor import on 2024-10-10. If that was incorrect we could remap to a more granular MCC that might be allowed. However, tinkering with MCCs has downstream tax/reporting implications. Recommend not changing retroactively.

ana (support): Emily — quick Q: is your company using an AmEx corporate travel & expense product or a corporate purchasing card? Sometimes purchasing cards have tighter MCC restrictions.

emily (customer): It's a Purchasing Card (P-Card). Ok — sounds like ACH is the fastest fix. Please send secure link.

sachin (account-manager): Looping in me to assist with vendor communication and approvals. Emily — I can confirm vendor will accept ACH and send remittance instructions if needed.

ana (support): Derek — create secure bank-collection link and post here when ready. Marking this thread to high priority.

derek (payments): Created secure vault link: https://vault.redwood.internal/bank/collect/gt3a9 — expires in 12h. Will not auto-submit until customer confirms.

emily (customer): Submitted ACH via link. Let me know if you need anything else.

derek (payments): Received. Initiating one-off ACH payout now. Will update when settlement confirmed.

billing-bot: Payout initiated: method=ACH status=processing ref=invoice_8427 provider_txn=ach_9XhzA. Estimated settlement 3-5 business days.

ana (support): Thanks team. Keeping this open until ACH confirms. For product follow-up: Ryan, can you add a short-term telemetry flag when vendor_mcc != allowed_mccs for corporate cards so we can proactively surface these before payout?

ryan (eng): Yep — I'll sketch a plan: 1) evaluate card-level MCC allowlist per issuer, 2) surface warning during payout creation with decline risk = HIGH if mismatch. I'll post a short RFC in eng-payments channel by EOD tomorrow.

ana (support): Great. Closing with next steps: ACH initiated, customer will request MCC whitelist with AmEx, engineering to add preflight warnings.

emily (customer): Appreciate the quick help, team :heart: 

ana (support): Closing notes: ticket INC-4529 -> referred to finance for reconciliation, label 'mcc-decline'.
